about: AI Artificial Intelligence Ventures Inc. formerly known as ESG Global Impact Capital Inc., is a venture capital, private equity and venture debt firm specializing in seed/startups, early stage, growth capital, debt and equity investing. AI Artificial Intelligence Ventures Inc. is an innovative investment firm strategically investing in the AI revolution. The firm typically invests in the following sectors: consumer products in the health care sector , medical devices, nutraceuticals and nutritional products, business services and logistics; education and training; and AI emerging technologies. It seeks to invest in companies that have capital requirement between CAD 0.25 million ($0.26 million) and CAD 2 million ($2.04 million) and have Asset to Revenue ratio of less than 40%. It seeks to invest in the form of convertible debentures and prefers to take a board seat or observation rights in its portfolio companies. It only seeks minority stakes. AI Artificial Intelligence Ventures Inc. was founded in February 2010 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
